name: copy_record_fields_to_slot
description: Checks the status returned by a called routine and, when it is zero, runs five more calls and copies three 16-bit fields of the record passed in A0 into a slot of a global table, with the slot picked by a bit field of a global index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A0E
name: step_record_position_fields
description: Increments a counter field of the record up to a limit, then adds a scaled step read from a lookup table to one position field, undoing that addition if the field exceeds 30000, and updates a second field from a companion calculation.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A20
name: select_candidate_then_update_position
description: Scans a fixed series of candidates through a called routine and keeps the one with the smallest returned value, storing its pointer in the record; if no candidate qualifies it skips ahead, and otherwise it, after a follow-up check passes, decays a field, bumps a counter, and runs the scaled position update.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A6E
name: commit_record_after_double_check
description: When one called routine returns non-zero and a second returns zero, it runs five more calls and copies one global value and three 16-bit fields of the record into globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A78
name: commit_record_or_advance_position
description: When the first call returns non-zero, it optionally calls a routine for a value below 192 and then, after two further checks, copies a global and three record fields into globals; otherwise it advances the record's counter and position fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_record_fields_to_globals
description: When a called routine returns zero, it runs five more calls and copies a global value and three 16-bit fields of the record into global storage.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B0A
name: clamp_offset_then_latch
description: Clamps the difference between a requested value and a stored position to a limit taken from the record and applies a scaled step to two record fields; when a called check passes and the combined magnitude fits a scaled bound, it copies three fields into globals, sets a mode byte to 8, clears a status word and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B1C
name: clamp_step_then_latch
description: Clamps a requested offset to a symmetric limit, applies a scaled step to two record fields, and when a called check passes and the combined magnitude fits a scaled bound, copies three record fields into globals, sets a mode byte to 8, clears a status word and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B58
name: step_field_then_latch
description: Clamps a requested offset to a symmetric limit, applies a scaled step to one record field, and when a called check passes and the offset plus a second magnitude fits a scaled bound, copies three record fields into globals, sets a mode byte to 8, clears a status word and returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B7A
name: latch_if_within_bound
description: Takes the absolute value of a second argument and, when the first argument plus that magnitude fits a scaled bound from a record field, copies three record fields into globals, sets a mode byte to 8, clears a status word and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC0
name: dispatch_record_handler
description: Calls through the code pointer stored in a field of the record in A0 and returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC6
name: advance_and_check_hit_entry
description: Sets the record's counter field to ten, then either runs a function-pointer handler or advances the record's position fields, depending on a distance check and a flag bit. When the handler path finds the offset within range, it latches fields into globals and appends a small entry to a list held in a global pointer, returning eight.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D72
name: decay_and_step_position
description: Reduces a positive field by a scaled constant, increments a counter field up to a limit, and recomputes two position fields from table-scaled steps, clamping one of them when it exceeds 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D8A
name: advance_record_position_fields
description: Increments a counter field up to a limit, then recomputes two position fields from table-scaled steps, undoing the first position addition when it exceeds 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_proximity_to_reference
description: Sets a record field to ten and, while a global gate is zero, returns minus one if the record field lies within 8192 of a global reference value, setting the field to three; when a second argument is also within 4096 of the field, it stores 255 into a global byte. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_gated_offset_band
description: Sets a record field to ten and, while a global gate is zero, returns minus one when the absolute distance of an offset from 16384 is at least a threshold derived from a global value, setting the field to thirteen; a second argument within 4096 of the field stores 255 into a global byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F5A
name: check_offset_band_proximity
description: Sets a record field to ten, then returns minus one when the absolute distance of an offset from 16384 is at least a threshold derived from a global value, setting the field to four and storing 255 into a global byte when a second argument lies within 4096 of the field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0FA8
name: arm_record_once
description: If a status bit of the record is clear, sets it, installs this same routine as the record's code pointer, copies three record fields into globals, resets a global to minus one and returns zero after a called routine; if the bit is already set it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:103E
name: register_record_in_slot
description: Returns minus one when a flag bit of the record is already set; otherwise it sets the bit, clears a counter field, and records the record in one of two global slots while updating slot state bytes, then runs further calls and clears the matching slot when its flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_counter_when_idle
description: When a global byte is zero, adds one plus a global increment to a global counter, calls a routine, and sets a global value to fourteen.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:118E
name: check_offset_band_above_floor
description: Returns zero only when a second argument is at least a record field times four and the absolute distance of a record field from 16384 is below a threshold derived from a global value; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11AC
name: check_offset_band_inside
description: Returns zero when the absolute distance of a record field from 16384 is below a threshold derived from a global value, and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11D6
name: check_distance_above_floor
description: Returns zero when a second argument is at least a record field times four and the absolute difference between a record field and a global reference exceeds 8192; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11F4
name: check_distance_beyond_threshold
description: Returns zero when the absolute difference between a record field and a global reference exceeds 8192, and minus one otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:120A
name: tick_entry_countdowns
description: Walks a table of entries 50 bytes apart, decrements each active entry's countdown and reloads it by division when it reaches zero, and clears a flag bit on inactive entries. When a countdown equals four and a global is negative, it calls a routine and sets a flag bit on the entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1280
name: spawn_firing_entry
description: After a called routine returns non-zero, it picks a type code from range checks on a value and, when a set of range and flag tests pass, copies fields of the source record into a table slot chosen by a counter modulo a global, links the source record, and increments a global counter. The text FIRING is referenced nearby.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:146A
name: scale_fields_when_active
description: Returns zero when a record field is zero or minus one; otherwise, after a called routine, it returns a value computed from two record fields and a global, scaled by shifts.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14B6
name: run_entry_handlers_loop
description: Copies a global into a previous-value global, resets a running index, and then calls the code pointer stored in each record of a table, stepping 86 bytes per entry for as many entries as a global count holds.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14E8
name: select_nearest_idle_entry
description: When a count is below a limit and a computed quotient condition holds, scans table entries whose flag bits match a mask, keeps the entry with the smallest value returned by a called routine, and when one is found copies a global into another and calls two routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1576
name: integrate_clamped_motion_step
description: Advances a counter field toward a stored limit and, when a flag bit is clear, clamps a step field to a stored limit and integrates it into position fields with a scaled constant; it then recomputes the position fields from table lookups.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15DE
name: reset_or_track_linked_entry
description: Computes the distance between the record and a referenced record and calls a routine; when that distance is below 17, it marks the record active, installs this routine as its code pointer, clears its motion fields and sets a size field to 12 or 140 by a flag bit. Otherwise it integrates the motion fields toward the referenced record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1678
name: decay_timer_then_step_motion
description: Counts a timer field down by a scaled constant, or when it reaches zero clears a flag and installs one of two handler routines by a global index, then computes table-driven motion updates for the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:169A
name: arm_handlers_when_index_reached
description: Clears a flag bit and, once a global index reaches a limit, sets flag bits, installs two handler routines and computes table-driven motion updates for the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16B6
name: arm_handlers_and_step_motion
description: Sets flag bits, installs two handler routines, and computes table-driven motion updates for the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16D0
name: adjust_timer_and_step_motion
description: Resets or increments an accumulator field depending on a timer threshold and clears a motion field; then it either advances a timer toward a limit or clears a flag and restores a saved handler, followed by table-driven motion updates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16DE
name: advance_timer_and_step_motion
description: Increments an accumulator field when a size field is below 300, clears a motion field, then either advances a timer toward a limit or clears a flag and restores a saved handler, followed by table-driven motion updates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1708
name: restore_handler_and_step_motion
description: Clears a flag bit, restores a saved handler pointer into the record, and computes table-driven motion updates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1718
name: update_record_and_queue_entry
description: Advances a record's counter and motion fields and, when a distance test and two magnitude tests pass, computes scaled table values into globals and records a small entry in a global list before returning eight; otherwise it returns a status.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1904
name: integrate_steered_motion
description: Chooses a target step from a pointed argument, clamps it against a limit and a record field, and integrates it into the record's position and velocity fields with a clamped correction.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1940
name: integrate_motion_with_reflection
description: Scales a pointed argument, clamps it against a record field and limit, integrates it into position fields, and reflects the position fields by subtracting 32768 when a related field's magnitude exceeds 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1960
name: scan_candidates_until_in_range
description: When a flag bit is clear and a timing mask test passes, it compares a returned value with 22400 and, beyond that, reinstalls a handler and clears flags; otherwise it scans up to eight candidates through called routines and stops at the first whose value falls below a threshold.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:197C
name: scan_candidates_then_advance
description: Under a timing mask test, compares a returned value with 22400 and, beyond it, reinstalls a handler and clears flags; otherwise it scans up to eight candidates for the first below a threshold, then advances a counter field toward a limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A14
name: search_bounded_candidates_then_arm
description: Loops over a bounded set of candidates, testing an absolute offset and a returned value against bounds, then advances a counter field toward a limit and, when a returned value is below 17, saves a pointer and installs a handler.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_record_handler_state
description: Installs a routine pointer in the record, clears a flag mask in its status word, and zeroes a second field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A32
name: return_offset_from_record_field
description: Calls three routines and returns the difference between a parameter value and a record field, shifted right by five bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_empty_handler
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing; it is reached through an address-taken pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A7A
name: integrate_flagged_motion_step
description: Takes a clamped step from a stored field when a flag bit is clear, or a fixed 1024 when it is set, integrates it into position fields with a scaled factor, and reflects the position fields by subtracting 32768 when a field's magnitude exceeds 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A88
name: integrate_motion_with_clamp
description: Integrates a clamped step into position fields using a scaled factor, clamps a related field to plus or minus 1024, and reflects the position fields by subtracting 32768 when a field's magnitude exceeds 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A98
name: integrate_limited_motion_step
description: Clamps a parameter to the negative of a stored limit, integrates the result into two position fields with a scaled factor, and reflects them by subtracting 32768 when a field's magnitude exceeds 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AB0
name: integrate_limited_motion_table
description: Clamps a parameter to the negative of a stored limit, integrates it into position fields, reflects them past 16384, and then computes table-driven values from the reflected position.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AF0
name: clamp_step_and_fire
description: Clamps a requested step to a symmetric limit, adds it to a record field, reflects the position fields past 16384, computes table-driven outputs, and calls several routines. The text fired by is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1E7E
name: register_pending_handler_entry
description: When the record's size field is below one, clears a flag and installs this routine as its handler; it then stores the record's three words as a pending entry, resets a timer when a global index matches, and when the low index bits are zero it stores table-scaled values into globals before returning a result from a further routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialise_record_from_template
description: Sets a record's position fields from a template with a global-scaled offset, sets a size field to 12 or 140 and a timer to 10 or 100 by a template flag bit, sets status flags, and installs its own handler; when the record lies within the table it calls five routines. The text taking off is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1FFA
name: update_frame_scale_and_timers
description: Derives a scale value from a global clamped to the range 4 to 15, halving it when a flag is set, derives two thresholds from it, calls eight routines, decrements a countdown, increments a tick counter, and sets a global to 255 with a timer of 5000 when a second countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_countdowns_keep_register
description: Decrements two global countdown values while they are non-zero and returns its input data register unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_two_countdowns
description: Decrements two global countdown values while they are non-zero and returns nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20F6
name: advance_entries_and_check_proximity
description: Advances each active entry in two tables by its velocity terms and decrements its lifetime counter, deactivating an entry when the summed absolute distance to a reference point falls below a threshold and calling three routines. The text destroyed by gunfire and Hit by gunfire is referenced.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:22C2
name: advance_slot_accumulators
description: When a stored pointer is negative it clears one slot chosen by a counter; otherwise it adds constant increments to eight slots' accumulator fields and stores a slot record when the counter's low nibble is zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:234C
name: decay_term_into_accumulator
description: When a counter is positive, reduces a term by 12 while it is above minus 16, then adds that term into a second global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2372
name: store_pair_and_set_flag
description: Sets a global byte to 255, stores the caller's data register value into a table word and a global value beside it, then calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_position_and_derive_pair
description: Clamps two global position values into fixed ranges (512 to 32256 and 512 to 32000), calls several routines depending on a flag, and derives two scaled values from input words into globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2466
name: copy_positions_and_floor_timers
description: Copies three global position values into a saved set, then raises a timer field of each active entry in a table to at least a value derived from a global index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_nearest_flagged_entry
description: Scans a count of entries in a table, skipping entries whose flag bits fail a mask, and keeps the entry whose summed absolute distances from two global positions is smallest, storing its pointer and that distance capped at 32767.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:259C
name: clear_flag_and_call_handler
description: Clears a global, makes a call, and when a field of the record is non-zero calls a routine, then clears the global again before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:25A0
